verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt (HTTP 200) at support.pagerduty.com indexing the knowledge base. Support docs are also served as agent-friendly .md pages, and the developer docs are published as raw Markdown on GitHub, including an MCP doc page, so an agent can be pointed at clean text sources. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms.txt (or llms-full.txt) covering the developer/API docs at developer.pagerduty.com, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs effectively.
